identity._comment: Greece accounts hold SEVERAL clients — the screenshot shows three applications side by side — and VFS sends one invitation per client. So identity resolution here does real work, unlike Italy where one-client-per-account makes it trivial. The base's strict defaults are exactly right and are not relaxed.

steps._comment: Everything else — the container, the name label, the 'Book Now' link — is inherited. The screenshot shows Greece's dashboard is the standard VFS layout, so there is nothing route-specific to override yet.

_comment_reference_join: THE KEY FACT FOR THIS ROUTE, confirmed by the user: the dashboard's 'Group Reference Number' is the SAME value the registration confirmation email calls the 'Unique Reference Number'. That equality is what makes identity exact here — the reference is stored at registration and used to pick the dashboard row, with the invitation's name only narrowing the shortlist first.
_comment_validity: Greece's invitation is valid for 36 HOURS, not 48. That lives in config/inbox/AE-GRC.json, where the email is parsed — it is a property of the message, not of the booking flow, and duplicating it here would create two places to get it wrong.
